Atavistik Bio will collaborate with Roche
to discover novel small molecule therapeutics against multiple targets for cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic (CVRM) diseases.

The deal centers on Atavistik's proprietary AMPS drug discovery platform, which is used "to identify novel functional binding pockets and advance selective small molecule therapeutics against targets for CVRM diseases," according to a news release. "By uncovering cryptic, biologically relevant binding pockets, Atavistik Bio’s platform enables new approaches to develop differentiated small molecules against therapeutically important targets that have historically been challenging to modulate."
call for Atavistik to receive an upfront payment of $70M and milestone payments of up to $1.9B, plus tiered royalties on sales of approved treatments.
Atavistik Bio will handle discovery and research for the collaboration targets, while Roche is responsible for preclinical and clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization activities.

title: Roche, Atavistik Bio partner on allosteric drug discovery
